kicker: A SCENT FOR EVERY ONE OF THEM
headline: Elden Ring Nightreign
lede: Three nights in the Limveld. Eight Nightfarers, and two more out of the Forsaken Hollows — each one a different way to survive the dark. Here is what each of them would wear.

entries.epithet: the sellsword · greatsword, buckler, stake driver
entries.line: Amouage built Interlude on chaos and turmoil. Oregano and pimento open dusty as a road, then frankincense smoke settles over leather and refuses to leave. Not the gunpowder — the smoke after it.

entries.epithet: the shield · a warrior of the Crest
entries.line: Temple gold. Frankincense and saffron over amber — the smell of somewhere you are safe, worn by the one who makes it so.

entries.epithet: the marksman · kills from where you cannot reach
entries.line: Cold air held at distance. Green tea, blackcurrant and a mineral edge that never warms up. Clean, quiet, and already gone.

entries.epithet: the dagger · she rewinds what was done
entries.line: Iris butter and violet over white musk. Aristocratic, powdered, and it vanishes into skin — you notice it after she has moved.

entries.epithet: the brute · nothing subtle survives him
entries.line: Whisky cream and mandarin into cocoa and Kashmir wood, on benzoin and tonka. A hot wind carrying spice, and no interest in being polite.

entries.epithet: the mourner · she brings her dead with her
entries.line: Mandarin and orange blossom into magnolia and young tuberose, on white leather and white musk. A bouquet carried by something that is not alive.

entries.epithet: the sorceress · she reads the blood in the air
entries.line: Raspberry and saffron over oud and benzoin, thick with incense. Arcane, purple, and far too heavy for anyone who is not casting something.

entries.epithet: the blade · he keeps a beast on a leash
entries.line: Saffron and Turkish rose over red berries, down to oud, leather and cypriol. Red fruit reads as blood; the leather is what holds the blade.

entries.epithet: of the Forsaken Hollows · he read his way here
entries.line: Cedar, ink and moss with galbanum cutting through. A room full of books that nobody has opened a window in.

entries.epithet: of the Forsaken Hollows · she buries what the night leaves
entries.line: Grapefruit and cypress into incense, myrrh and benzoin. Church resin and the graveyard tree — a funeral you can wear.
